name: @vrmxg/render
description: The VRMXG render host: a WebGL or WebGPU renderer (M4 W0: backend choice, warm-up, node frame per offline frame) set up for MToon, presentation interpolated at the clock's α without touching simulated state, Environment and light nodes with shadow presets and frozen shadow maps, and debug draw for colliders, sensors, character capsules and rays.
